title: hieracium limitaneum
intro: Hieracium limitaneum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species belonging to the sunflower family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Hawkweed include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
